answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks via key-bound Proof-of-Space-Time. Each agent stores a unique, incompressible disk plot derived from its key and answers frequent beacon challenges under tight timeouts so it cannot recompute proofs or mirror a peer's data. Each fake identity thus costs dedicated disk capacity and read bandwidth. Yet even if telemetry flags surges in violet, wealthy actors can rent cloud arrays to sustain a brief comet of valid identities.
